cases.name: poisson_plain_utc_day
cases.note: UTC timezone: local day == UTC day, no min gap

cases.name: poisson_min_gap_within_day
cases.note: [H] min gap shifts candidates to prev+min_gap within a UTC day

cases.name: poisson_min_gap_not_across_utc_midnight
cases.note: [H] pair closer than min_gap across 00:00Z is NOT shifted

cases.name: poisson_local_day_two_utc_days
cases.note: [H] LA local day spans two UTC days; both generated, filtered to bounds

cases.name: poisson_config_change_mid_day
cases.note: [H] piecewise: v1 before 22:00Z, v2 after

cases.name: poisson_day_after_config_change
cases.note: [H] day D+1 fully under v2, identical to v2-only generation

cases.name: non_monotonic_effective_from
cases.note: [H] v3 effective before v2: highest-effective-version rule; v2 never in effect, and identical v1/v3 protocols produce no duplicate instants

cases.name: poisson_seed_edit
cases.note: same day, different stream seed -> different times

cases.name: stratified_normal_day
cases.note: 24 h day: 2 full 10 h intervals + 4 h partial -> floor(5*0.4)=2 pings

cases.name: stratified_23h_day
cases.note: [H] spring-forward 23 h day: 2 full intervals + 3 h partial -> floor(5*0.3)=1

cases.name: stratified_25h_day
cases.note: [H] fall-back 25 h day: 2 full intervals + 5 h partial -> floor(5*0.5)=2

cases.name: fixed_interval_basic
cases.note: anchor 09:00 local, every 3 h until end of local day

cases.name: fixed_interval_spring_forward_anchor
cases.note: [H] anchor 02:30 nonexistent -> pre-transition instant, suppressed(dst); later emissions clean

cases.name: fixed_interval_through_fall_back
cases.note: [H] hourly through the fall-back: UTC spacing stays 60 min, 25 emissions

cases.name: fixed_times_basic_matching_day
cases.note: 2026-08-19 is a Wednesday: all three times

cases.name: fixed_times_nonmatching_day
cases.note: Thursday: empty

cases.name: fixed_times_spring_forward
cases.note: [H] 02:30 nonexistent -> 10:30Z suppressed(dst)

cases.name: fixed_times_fall_back_first_occurrence
cases.note: [H] 01:30 duplicated -> first occurrence (PDT, 08:30Z)

cases.name: collision_same_second
cases.note: [H] identical times shift +1 s in times_local order

cases.name: collision_dst_resolved_candidate
cases.note: [H] 02:30 (nonexistent, ->10:30Z) collides with real 03:30 PDT (10:30Z); later-in-order 03:30 shifts to 10:30:01Z

cases.name: collision_shift_past_day_end
cases.note: [H] 61 collisions at 23:59: the last shifts to 00:00:00Z of the next day but remains assigned to the generating day

cases.name: quiet_zone_plain_half_open
cases.note: window [13:00,15:00): 13:00 and 14:59 suppressed, 12:00 and 15:00 not; applies to fixed_times (suppressed, not skipped)

cases.name: quiet_zone_midnight_wrap
cases.note: window starts Thu 23:00, wraps to Fri 07:30: Fri 07:00 suppressed (tail of Thu window), Fri 22:59 not, Fri 23:30 not (Fri not listed)

cases.name: quiet_zone_spanning_spring_forward
cases.note: quiet zone 23:00-07:30 across the transition is an hour shorter in elapsed time; evaluated on wall clock

cases.name: disabled_stream_empty
cases.note: disabled stream generates nothing (off != suppressed)
